interestIds.description: When empty, every interest of the fund is called.

postAsDraft.description: When true, the capital call stays a draft: no journal is posted and no notice is sent. When false, the capital call is also released, the same as Approve & Release in the app: its journal is posted.

externalReferenceId.description: Used for idempotency on externalReferenceId and sourceSystem.

sourceSystem.description: Used for idempotency on externalReferenceId and sourceSystem.
